test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: On what does the pressure and wind system of any area depend?

options.text: Distance from the sea and latitude
Latitude and altitude of the place
Longitude and distance from the sea

solution:
The correct answer is __**Latitude and altitude of the place**__
